about: Hand-written rotation guides for the warlock's player pages (guides.py).

raid.plan: Affliction in a raid keeps **Curse of the Elements** and three damage-over-time spells on the boss and fills every gap with **Shadow Bolt**, about half your damage, with a Succubus out. Apart from **Amplify Curse**, your Affliction talents add no buttons: they make your dots and Shadow spells hit harder.
why: **Curse of the Elements** goes up first: one cast lasts 5 minutes and makes the boss take 10% more damage from every magic school, Shadow and Fire alike (Curse of Shadow is gone in Forever). It is a Curse and **Bane of Agony** is a Bane, so both stay on the boss together; the simulator measured the curse 0.2% better at the top of the list.

**Life Tap** waits until you are below 10% mana: every tap is a global cooldown with no damage, so the later you tap, the less mana you leave unspent when the boss dies. It stops 6 seconds before the end (the simulator measured that 0.25% better), and a mana potion below 75% mana or a Demonic Rune below 60% comes first.

**Amplify Curse** goes before the pull and again whenever it comes back (3-minute cooldown): it makes your next **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger. Its 30 seconds outlast the 24-second Bane, so pressing it early never wastes it.

**Bane of Agony** starts weak and grows over its 24 seconds, so recast it only once it has run out: refreshing it early throws away its strongest ticks. **Corruption** is instant with 5 points in **Improved Corruption**, so it goes back up the moment it drops.
Start a new **Immolate** when less time is left on the old one than its cast (1.5 seconds with the **Bane** talent), so the new one lands about as the old one ends.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler. Its critical strikes trigger **Improved Shadow Bolt** (20% more Shadow damage from you for 12 seconds, your dots included), and **Malevolence** and **Ruin** make those crits more frequent and bigger. With **Nightfall**, as in the other build below, a proc makes your next **Shadow Bolt** instant: the list needs no change.
caveats: **Searing Pain** has no cooldown: the rotation casts it only in the last 3.5 seconds, where its 1.5-second cast lands before the boss dies and a **Shadow Bolt** might not. Never use it as a filler: it does less damage per second of casting than **Shadow Bolt** and causes a high amount of threat.

Your Succubus does about 8% of your damage with her attacks and **Lash of Pain**, and she takes 17% of your spell damage as attack power and 10% as spell damage. If she dies with less than about two minutes of the fight left, finish without her: a 10-second **Summon Succubus** costs about as much damage as she would add.
Moving costs you **Shadow Bolt** casts, so move with your instants: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony**, **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse** and **Life Tap**.

The simulator measured only one boss. On a second target that lives a while, an instant **Corruption** and **Bane of Agony** add damage for one global cooldown each; **Bane of Doom** takes the same Bane slot and deals its damage only after a full minute, and the simulated rotations keep **Bane of Agony**.
diverge: Near the end of a fight, start no dot the boss will not outlive: on the training dummy the simulator measured it better to start no **Immolate** in the last 20 seconds and no **Corruption** in the last 10. Cast **Shadow Bolt** then, and **Searing Pain** in the last 3.5 seconds.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters or **Curse of Tongues** on a caster boss.
When healing is tight, each **Life Tap** costs health someone must heal: use your mana potion and Demonic Rune before you tap.

leveling.plan: Affliction levels by letting its damage-over-time spells do the killing while the Voidwalker holds the mob: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** on a healthy mob, **Shadow Bolt** while the mob has more than about a third of its health, then the wand while the dots finish it.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first: its **Torment** holds the mob while you stand at range, and your dots build threat slowly enough that it keeps the mob. **Amplify Curse** (level 20) goes on whenever it is ready (3-minute cooldown): it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.

**Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** (level 30) go on once each, none of them on a mob below about a third of its health: it dies before the spell pays for its mana. The 2026-10-20 re-tune measured the 35% rule on **Corruption** about 2% faster per kill, and keeping **Corruption** for when you have more than 15% mana a little under 1%.

**Shadow Bolt** fills while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you keep the mana for **Fear** and **Drain Life**; below that, your wand while the dots finish the mob. The tuned rule (no **Shadow Bolt** on a mob below 35%) measured about 6.5% faster per kill, the largest gain of the re-tune.

**Immolate** only on a mob above about half its health and while you have more than half your mana: it costs the most of your dots, and the fight lab casts it on one mob in two at level 20 and one in five at 60.

**Drain Life** below 60% health, and in place of the wand below 85% (**Improved Drains** and **Soul Siphon** make it stronger). **Life Tap** in a fight only when the next **Shadow Bolt** would eat into your **Fear** and **Drain Life** mana, while you stay above 60% health; between fights tap back to about 70% mana and eat only below 55% health.
caveats: No **Curse of the Elements** while leveling: the 2026-10-20 re-tune measured about 2-3% faster per kill without it (it costs a global cooldown and mana on a mob that dies quickly).
This build has no **Wrack** and no **Nightfall**. With **Wrack**, the fight lab channels it once **Corruption** is up.

Affliction is the one warlock list that drinks: **Shadow Bolt** spends mana faster than the other specs' wand-heavy play, and when you are too hurt to **Life Tap** you drink below 15% mana (about 6-8 seconds per kill in the fight lab).

When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage), otherwise **Fear** it and **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back.
diverge: Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new spell on it.
Below about a third of your health with a mob on you, use a Healthstone (**Create Healthstone** between fights).

If the Voidwalker dies, summon a new one before the next pull rather than fight without your tank, and heal a hurt one between fights with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in combat) or **Health Funnel**.

raid.plan: Demonology in a raid is a **Shadow Bolt** caster with two demons' worth of bonuses: you sacrifice the Imp for 15% more Shadow damage, and **Demonic Pact** keeps that buff while your Succubus fights. Then you keep **Curse of the Elements** and your dots up and cast **Shadow Bolt**.
why: Before the pull: summon the Imp, use **Demonic Sacrifice** (+15% Shadow damage for 2 hours), then summon the Succubus and turn on **Soul Link**. **Demonic Pact** keeps the sacrifice while a different demon is out, but summoning the Imp again cancels it; the simulator measured about 10% less damage without the sacrifice.

The Succubus earns her place: while she is out, **Master Demonologist** gives you and her 10% more Shadow damage, **Soul Link** 3% more damage and **Demonic Knowledge** 60 more spell damage at level 60. She takes 17% of your spell damage as attack power and 10% as spell damage, and her attacks and **Lash of Pain** add about 9% of your damage.

**Curse of the Elements** goes up first: 10% more damage from every magic school for 5 minutes, and as a Curse it sits beside your **Bane of Agony**. **Life Tap** waits until you are below 5% mana: every tap is a global cooldown with no damage, and the simulator measured tapping at 5% about 0.5% better than at 10%.

**Bane of Agony** grows over its 24 seconds, so recast it only once it has run out. **Corruption** (a 1.6-second cast with this build's single point of **Improved Corruption**) goes back up when less time is left on it than its cast, but not in the last 10 seconds.

**Immolate** is Fire, so none of your Shadow bonuses reach it, and it only just pays: the simulator measured this spec better without it when it was recast to the very end, and better with it when you stop 20 seconds before the end. Start it when less than its 1.5-second cast is left on the old one.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler because every bonus you stacked is Shadow: the sacrificed Imp, **Master Demonologist** and **Improved Shadow Bolt**'s 20% after your own crits. **Decimation** adds 6% to it once the boss is below 35% health.
caveats: **Searing Pain** has no cooldown: the rotation casts it only in the last 3.5 seconds, when its 1.5-second cast lands before the boss dies and a **Shadow Bolt** might not. So **Demonic Brand** and the **Soul Fire** half of **Decimation** do nothing here: they are points on the way to deeper talents, and the simulator found **Soul Fire** a loss wherever it tried it.

If the Succubus dies, summon her again unless the boss is about to die (6 seconds with **Master Summoner**) and turn **Soul Link** back on: without a demon you lose **Master Demonologist**, **Soul Link**, **Demonic Knowledge** and her own damage. Never summon the Imp during the fight: that cancels your sacrifice even with **Demonic Pact**.

Summon her after your buffs, wizard oil and Spellstone (**Create Spellstone**) are on: in this project's model a demon copies its share of your spell damage when it is summoned. Forever lets the Spellstone stack with the oil, and the simulator measured about 3% more damage from it.
On the move, **Bane of Agony**, **Curse of the Elements** and **Life Tap** are instant; **Corruption** keeps a 1.6-second cast in this build, so put it back when you stand still.
diverge: In the last 20 seconds start no new **Immolate**, and in the last 10 no **Corruption**: cast **Shadow Bolt**, then **Searing Pain** in the last 3.5 seconds.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters.

leveling.plan: Demonology levels on the Voidwalker and the wand: it holds the mob, **Demonic Brand** (levels 28-29 and 34) turns **Searing Pain** into extra Voidwalker damage, and your dots from the Affliction points do the rest. **Shadow Bolt** only with nearly full mana, which this list rarely leaves you.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first: **Unholy Power** (levels 10-14), **Improved Voidwalker** (24-26), **Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) and **Master Demonologist** (35-39) make it and you stronger, and **Soul Link** (30) moves 30% of the damage you take to it and adds 3% damage for both. **Demonic Sacrifice** is only the step to **Soul Link**: never sacrifice your tank.

**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone and the Voidwalker is hitting the mob: the Voidwalker's next attacks (6 with all 3 points) each deal about 65 extra damage at level 60, and the brand halves **Searing Pain**'s own threat. The fight lab casts it about twice per kill from level 30.

**Bane of Agony** and, from level 60, **Siphon Life** on every mob above about a third of its health. **Corruption** only while you have more than half your mana: the 2026-10-20 re-tune measured that about 3% faster per kill, and it leaves **Corruption** off about half the mobs at 40-60. **Immolate** needs half your mana too, so after level 30 it is rare.

The wand is your filler. **Shadow Bolt** and filler **Searing Pain** wait for 80% mana, and with the brands and dots you almost never get there: the fight lab casts no **Shadow Bolt** past level 20, and needs no drinking at any level.

**Drain Life** below 60% health and in place of the wand below 85%; **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health (rare). Between fights, **Life Tap** back to 70% mana, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows**, eat below 55% health.
caveats: This build has no **Decimation** and no **Improved Health Funnel**, so the **Soul Fire** and in-fight **Health Funnel** lines do not apply.
**Improved Imp** does nothing while the Voidwalker is out: those 3 points only help reach the deeper talents.
When a mob reaches you, cast **Death Coil** if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage), otherwise **Fear** it and let the Voidwalker take it back.
diverge: If the Voidwalker dies, finish the mob with dots, **Death Coil** and the wand, and summon a new one before the next pull: without a demon out you also lose **Demonic Knowledge**, **Soul Link** and **Master Demonologist**.
Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new dot on it.

raid.plan: Destruction in a raid is still a **Shadow Bolt** spec: you sacrifice the Imp for 15% more Shadow damage, keep **Immolate** on the boss so **Conflagrate** can go out every 10 seconds, and let **Shadow and Flame** turn each **Conflagrate** into 10% more Shadow damage.
why: Before the pull: summon the Imp, use **Demonic Sacrifice** (+15% Shadow damage for 2 hours; summoning any demon ends it), then **Life Tap** once so you start full. Put a Spellstone (**Create Spellstone**) on your weapon on top of your wizard oil: Forever lets them stack, and the simulator measured about 3% more damage. This build has no **Amplify Curse**; without the sacrifice the simulator measured about 10% less damage.

**Curse of the Elements** goes up first: 10% more damage from every magic school, Fire and Shadow alike, and as a Curse it sits beside your **Bane of Agony**. **Life Tap** waits until you are below 5% mana (the simulator measured that 0.4% better than 10%), and **Improved Life Tap** adds 20% to each tap.

**Bane of Agony** grows over its 24 seconds, so recast it only once it has run out. **Corruption** (0.8 seconds with 3 points in **Improved Corruption**) goes back up when it is about to run out, but not in the last 10 seconds.

**Immolate** matters as much for **Conflagrate**, which needs it on the target, as for its own damage: start a new one when less than its cast (1.5 seconds with the **Bane** talent) is left on the old one, but not in the last 20 seconds. Both end-of-fight cut-offs measured small gains.

**Conflagrate** goes out whenever it is ready. With 5 points in **Shadow and Flame** it no longer eats your **Immolate**, and each hit gives you 10% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds, twice its cooldown; **Fire and Brimstone** and **Ruin** make its crits frequent and big. The simulator measured adding it at about 8% more damage.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler, not **Incinerate**: the sacrificed Imp, **Improved Shadow Bolt** and **Shadow and Flame** raise Shadow damage only. Even the Incinerate build's own rotation search put **Shadow Bolt** ahead of **Incinerate** in a raid.
caveats: The last seconds belong to quick spells: with 3.5 seconds left the rotation casts **Searing Pain** (a 1.5-second cast) and with 1.5 left an instant **Shadowburn**, because a **Shadow Bolt** still casting when the boss dies does nothing. Neither belongs earlier in the fight.

**Shadowburn** on cooldown measured worse in the fire rotation (about 0.8%): it costs nearly as much mana as **Shadow Bolt** for about two thirds of the damage. Keep it for the last global cooldown, or for a moment when you must move.
With the Imp sacrificed you play without a demon: any summon ends the buff, so if you die, summon the Imp and sacrifice it again before the next pull.
On the move, **Bane of Agony**, **Curse of the Elements**, **Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn** and **Life Tap** are instant; **Corruption** still has a 0.8-second cast in this build.
diverge: If you play the Incinerate build listed above instead, it still fills with **Shadow Bolt** in a raid: its full-raid rotation adds **Shadowburn** on cooldown (with 10 or more seconds left) and keeps **Shadow Bolt** ahead of **Incinerate**.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters.

leveling.plan: Destruction levels with the same Voidwalker and Affliction dots as the other specs, since its first 21 points are Affliction, and adds **Immolate** and, from level 56, **Conflagrate**. This build takes neither **Incinerate** nor **Shadowburn**; your filler is the wand, with **Shadow Bolt** only when your mana is nearly full.
why: **Corruption** and **Bane of Agony** go first: both are instant (with 5 points in **Improved Corruption**) and cheap, and they give the Voidwalker time to build threat before your fire spells land. **Amplify Curse** before the pull makes that **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger, and **Siphon Life** joins at level 30. Skip **Corruption** and **Bane of Agony** on a mob below about a third of its health (the 2026-10-20 re-tune measured the **Corruption** rule about 1% faster per kill).

**Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: the 2026-10-20 re-tune measured that about 3% faster per kill than casting it whenever the **Fear** and **Drain Life** reserve allows. It also waits until it cannot pull the mob off the Voidwalker. **Aftermath** makes its first hit 50% stronger.

**Conflagrate** eats your **Immolate** in this build, so cast it when **Immolate** has about 3 seconds left, or to finish a burning mob it would kill. With the mana rule, **Immolate** is on few mobs at 60, so **Conflagrate** is a rare bonus, not the core of the list.
Your filler is the wand: **Shadow Bolt** and filler **Searing Pain** wait for 80% mana, which the dots rarely leave you (the fight lab casts almost none).

**Life Tap** when your mana runs short and your health is above 60%; between fights, **Life Tap** back to 70% mana and heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** or **Health Funnel**. Eat below 55% health.
caveats: This build has neither **Incinerate** nor **Shadowburn**: skip the lines that name them, and finish mobs with **Conflagrate** or the wand.
Until level 56 you have no **Conflagrate**: you play **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony**, **Siphon Life**, **Immolate**, then the wand.

When a mob reaches you, cast **Death Coil** if you are below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it and **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back. **Molten Skin** (10% less damage taken) and **Intensity** (casts that resist pushback) make those moments cheaper.
diverge: If you take **Incinerate** later, the fight lab's rotation casts it in place of **Shadow Bolt** on a burning mob: it deals 25% more damage while **Immolate** is on the target.
Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand or **Conflagrate** instead of a new **Immolate**: the fight lab starts no **Immolate** on a mob below about a third of its health.

You keep **Curse of the Elements** and three dots up and cast **Shadow Bolt** the rest of the time.

leveling.plan: The Shadow Bolt hybrid levels with the Destruction list but has no **Conflagrate**: a Voidwalker holds the mob while you put **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony**, **Immolate** and **Siphon Life** on it and finish with the wand. Despite the name, the tuned list casts almost no **Shadow Bolt**: it waits for 80% mana.

leveling.plan: The 25/26/0 split plays the Demonology list: a Voidwalker made stronger by its first 26 points holds the mob, **Searing Pain** keeps **Demonic Brand** on it, **Bane of Agony**, **Siphon Life** and (with mana to spare) **Corruption** tick, and the wand fills.
why: The first 26 points (levels 10-35) are Demonology and make the Voidwalker the main damage source: **Unholy Power** (10-14) adds 10% to its damage, **Improved Voidwalker** (16-18) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger, **Demonic Energies** (15 and 19) heals it for 15% of your spell damage, **Soul Link** (30) moves 30% of your damage taken to it and adds 3% damage for both, **Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) adds spell damage while it is out.

**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone and the Voidwalker is hitting the mob: **Demonic Brand** (levels 26-28) makes its next 6 attacks deal about 65 extra damage each at level 60 and halves **Searing Pain**'s threat. The fight lab casts it about twice per kill from level 30.

**Bane of Agony** on every mob above about a third of its health, **Siphon Life** from level 56. **Corruption** only while you have more than half your mana (the 2026-10-20 re-tune, about 3% faster per kill): about one mob in two at 40-60. **Immolate** needs half your mana too: about one mob in four after level 20, almost none at 60.

The wand is your filler: **Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% mana, which the brands and dots never leave you, and the fight lab needs no drinking. **Improved Corruption** (42-45 and 49) only makes **Corruption** instant late.

**Drain Life** below 60% health, and in place of the wand below 85%. **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health; between fights tap back to about 70% mana and eat only below 55% health.
caveats: This build has no **Decimation** and no **Improved Health Funnel**: skip the **Soul Fire** and in-fight **Health Funnel** lines. **Improved Sayaad**, **Fel Domination** and **Grim Reach** are steps to deeper talents; the fight lab gets nothing from them.

When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage), otherwise **Fear** it and **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back.

This split used to play the Affliction list (**Shadow Bolt** to a third of the mob's health); the open search found it in the Demonology list, where it levels about 20% faster per kill at levels 20-60 than the Affliction builds.
diverge: If the Voidwalker dies mid-fight, finish the mob with dots, **Death Coil** and the wand; **Master Summoner** shortens the next summon.
